gaps: the decisive step tests something else than the case's point: The available setup recipes cannot create a weighted RFQ with per-vendor weights, a second invited vendor, or multi-currency configuration.
The available read-back fields do not expose vendor weightages or currency preferences, so the plan cannot verify that the vendor sees only its own values.
